intro: Microsoft executive Brad Smith warned the BBC that artificial intelligence faces inadequate safety oversight, comparing it unfavorably to washing machine regulations and calling for global governance standards. Apple introduced HomeView, an iPad-like smart home hub with an upgraded Siri, while Anthropic raised concerns that freely available small AI models could self-replicate across devices like smart TVs and ovens within months. An FBI arrest of an OpenAI employee for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in the company's offices has drawn attention to security vulnerabilities amid AI research competition.
